record.original_question: Consider the sevenfold star construction of finite geodesic nets G_n(phi). The construction starts from seven equally spaced outer vertices, defines an inner layer V_0 using the fixed algebraic angle alpha_0 = 88/21 radians and a small deviation angle phi, and then recursively builds layers V_i by winging vertices and, when needed, suspending an odd layer from one nearest outer hook or an even layer from two nearest outer hooks. For each layer V_i define a suspension-angle function phi_i(phi): for odd i, phi_i is the angle OPv between the outer-circle center O, the hook P, and the suspended vertex v; for even i, phi_i is the angle OXv, where X is the third vertex of the equilateral triangle on the two hooks P,Q and v is the suspended vertex, with phi_0(phi)=phi. Since every phi_i(0)=0 and the construction depends smoothly on phi, is the derivative sequence phi_i_prime(0) pairwise nonrepeating?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Sevenfold star construction. Place seven equally spaced "outer vertices" on a circle of center O in the Euclidean plane (vertices of a regular heptagon). Fix the algebraic angle α₀ = 88/21 radians and a small real parameter φ. Define the zeroth layer V₀ of inner vertices by attaching, at each outer vertex, a pair of edges making angles α₀ ± φ with prescribed reference directions, in the standard way for this seven-pointed star construction. Recursively construct layers V₁, V₂, … as follows. Each new layer is obtained from the previous one by "winging" each vertex (locally extending the net so that the new vertex is balanced, i.e. the unit tangent vectors at it sum to zero). When such winging fails to balance, one performs a "suspension": an odd-indexed layer is suspended from a single nearest outer "hook" P, and an even-indexed layer is suspended from the two nearest outer hooks P, Q.

For each layer V_i define a suspension-angle function φ_i(φ) as follows:
• For odd i, with v the suspended vertex and P the (single) outer hook, set φ_i(φ) = ∠O P v.
• For even i ≥ 2, let X be the third vertex of the equilateral triangle built on the two hooks P, Q (on the side containing v) and set φ_i(φ) = ∠O X v.
• For i = 0, set φ_0(φ) = φ.

The construction depends smoothly on φ in a neighborhood of 0, and φ_i(0) = 0 for every i ≥ 0. Consider the sequence of derivatives
   a_i := φ_i'(0),  i = 0, 1, 2, …

Question: Is the sequence (a_i)_{i≥0} pairwise nonrepeating, i.e. a_i ≠ a_j whenever i ≠ j?
artifact.status_search_result: The conjecture appears in the work introducing the sevenfold star construction of geodesic nets by Nabutovsky and Parsch. Subsequent work on geodesic nets (including recent 2025 preprints on geodesic nets with few boundary vertices) does not announce a resolution of this specific nonrepetition conjecture for the suspension-angle derivatives. No source found that proves or disproves it, so the problem appears to remain open.
